about: Category B: observation statements from the results text of Fritsche-Guenther et al. 2011 (doi 10.1038/msb.2011.27, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), read after the pre-registration was committed (d37c0b4, 2026-10-04T13:22:25Z). One row per statement; the text is the host's short paraphrase, the evidence id is the span read. Figures, tables and supplements were not read. Nothing here was used to change prereg/case.json.

read.title: Efficiency of small-molecule inhibitors is impaired by strong negative feedback
In Ras-mutated cells, Raf-1 is feedback controlled whereas Ras is not
Feedback is fast and does not require translation or transcription
Post-translational feedback via Raf-1 mediates robustness
read.why: Read because O3 (pERK under the MEK inhibitor) had no statement in sec-14, -11 or -15, as the reading plan allowed.

genotype_check.statement: HT29 and RKO carry B-Raf V600E; HCT116 and SW480 carry K-Ras exon 2 mutations (D13E, G12V); LIM1215 has neither.
genotype_check.effect: The pre-registered genotype groups, fixed as an assumption from general knowledge, agree with the paper. Nothing was changed.

rows.question: O1
rows.cells: B-Raf wild-type cells; HCT116 and SW480 named in the next span (lit-56693f038783)
rows.statement: pMek levels rise sharply when Mek is inhibited in B-Raf wild-type cells.

rows.question: O2
rows.cells: B-Raf-mutated cells (lines not named in the span)
rows.statement: No increase of pMek in B-Raf-mutated cells.
rows.direction_note: The text says 'no increase'; a decrease is not excluded by the wording.

rows.question: O1
rows.statement: At inhibitor levels exceeding 20 uM, phospho-Mek levels drop in all cell lines; the authors' own model does not explain it.
rows.direction_note: A drop is stated, but not against untreated cells (it reads as a drop from the levels at lower doses). No direction versus untreated is stated.

rows.question: O2
rows.statement: As B03, for the B-Raf-mutated lines.

rows.question: O4
rows.statement: Raf-1 shows prominent phosphorylation at the ERK site cluster in control samples but not in U0126-treated cells.

rows.question: O5
rows.statement: No increase of Ras activation after abrogation of Erk activity in the Ras-mutated cells.
rows.direction_note: The text says 'no increase'; a decrease is not excluded by the wording.

rows.question: O3
rows.statement: U0126 was applied 'to abrogate Erk activity'; later spans refer to 'abrogation of Erk activity'.
rows.direction_note: Stated as the purpose of the treatment and presupposed afterwards; no pERK measurement under the inhibitor is reported in the text read.

rows.question: O1
rows.statement: Mek phosphorylation rises within 1 h post-inhibition.
rows.direction_note: The cell line is not named in the text read, so no genotype group can be assigned.

rows.question: O2

rows.question: O1
rows.cells: Caco2 with empty vector or wild-type B-Raf
rows.statement: Strong feedback regulation (pMek increase under the Mek inhibitor).

unregistered.statement: In BRAF-mutant HT29, Raf-1 S289/S296/S301 phosphorylation is also lost under U0126 (Raf-1 is feedback controlled there too, but without effect on the signal).
unregistered.why_not_scored: No pre-registered question asks for phospho-Raf-1 in the BRAF group.

unregistered.statement: U0126 accelerates the electrophoretic mobility of total Raf-1.
unregistered.why_not_scored: No model state or readout for Raf-1 mobility.

unregistered.statement: pMek increases in Ras-mutated cells after knockdown of Erk1, Erk2 or both; no increase in B-Raf-mutated cells (lit-395c8b700e26).
unregistered.why_not_scored: Erk knockdown is not a pre-registered intervention.

unregistered.statement: ppErk depends non-linearly on total Erk in Ras-mutated cells and linearly in B-Raf-mutated cells.
unregistered.why_not_scored: A quantitative relation; no pre-registered question and no Boolean counterpart.

unregistered.statement: The authors' ODE model predicts a three- to six-fold pMek increase on full Mek inhibition.
unregistered.why_not_scored: A model prediction, not an observation.
